The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
NOTICE UNDER SECTION 66C.(4) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE, AS AMENDED BY THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS (AMENDMENT) ACT, No. 22 OF 2012

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 66C of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, as amended by the Local Authorities Elections (Amendment) Act, No. 22 of 2012,1, Erandi Umanga Mendis the Commissioner of Local Government of the Department of Local Government, Southern Province, do hereby inform that the meeting that was convened and postponed on 27.06.2025 for the purpose of electing a Chairman and a Vice Chairman for a Local Authority within the Southern Province named in the schedule below, will be reconvened in terms of the section 66C.(4) of the said Ordinance at the specified time on the date correspondingly indicated under the schedule below at the venue mentioned therein .

Erandi Umanga Mendis,Commissioner of Local Government,Southern Province.Department of Local Government of Southern Province,6th Floor, Galle District Secretariat Building.On this 08th day of July 2025.
